title: Returning to Work After Parental Leave
paragraphs: After several months of parental leave following the birth of her second child, Nurul felt a mix of excitement and anxiety returning to work, worried she had fallen behind on important projects during her absence.

Her manager reassured her during her first week back, explaining clearly what had changed and pairing her with a colleague to help her catch up gradually rather than expecting immediate full performance.
The transition felt slower than she expected, and balancing pumping breaks with meetings required careful planning that had not been necessary before her leave began.

By the end of the second month, Nurul felt fully settled back into her role, later telling a friend that a supportive transition period made returning to work far less overwhelming than she had feared.
